record.one_liner: Sales CRM for inside sales teams with calling, SMS, email, pipelines, and automation, plus a REST API.
record.auth_notes: Close supports API keys for scripts/server-side integrations and OAuth 2.0 for user-facing apps. The official MCP server additionally accepts a Close-API-Key header or OAuth 2.0 with Dynamic Client Registration (DCR).
record.access_notes: Close offers a self-serve 14-day free trial (no credit card) via signup, and API access + event log API is listed as included on every paid plan tier (Solo, Essentials, Growth, Scale), so a developer can obtain API keys during the trial without sales contact.
record.api_breadth_basis: developer.close.com lists many distinct resource families: leads, contacts, activities, custom data, sequences, bulk email/SMS operations, reporting/metrics, pipeline data, webhooks, and a 30-day event log — spanning well beyond a single narrow resource.
record.blocker_notes: API access is available on all plans including the free trial, with self-serve API key generation and OAuth; an official vendor-hosted MCP server is also available, so a toolkit is buildable without approval gates.
